relationships.subject: ibuprofen
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings indicate that ibuprofen and indomethacin promote axonal growth through PPARγ activation, independent of COX inhibition

relationships.subject: PPAR-gamma
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results demonstrate that ibuprofen and indomethacin significantly enhance axonal growth through suppression of RhoA activation via PPARγ, independent of COX inhibition.

relationships.subject: GW1929
relationships.evidence_quote: ibuprofen (726 ± 77 μm, 837 ± 116 μm) and GW1929 (609 ± 54 μm, 727 ± 11 μm) significantly enhanced (p < 0.01) axonal growth compared to all other groups

relationships.subject: GW9662
relationships.evidence_quote: GW9662 (63 ± 26 μm, 63 ± 26 μm) significantly decreased (p < 0.001) axonal growth regardless of the presence of indomethacin

relationships.subject: CSPG
relationships.evidence_quote: Stimulation with CSPG (1.5 μg/mL; 30 min) induced high RhoA activation in control DRGs.

key_findings: Ibuprofen and indomethacin enhance DRG axonal growth and suppress CSPG-induced RhoA activation via PPARgamma, independent of COX inhibition (naproxen had no effect).
PPARgamma activation also potentiated KCl-evoked calcium signaling in DRG cultures.
